people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
translations.bsb: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splattered on the altar.
translations.kjv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
translations.asv: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
